label: AEP / Looma (Host-native route)
route_note: The application declares no action route at all; it declares a task boundary, a Result Contract and a deterministic step(validate_result) gate. The Host owns the route set, so the same command and the same file satisfy both splits.
widening_note: There is no widened variant: widening is a Host-side act and costs the application zero SLOC.
fixture_mode_note: host_driver.py only simulates the external Host for deterministic CI and is excluded from application LOC; the host tool trace is written to <output>.host.json.
